NAME: Force Audio Jack - Skipback
DESCRIPTION: Continuously records the Force's real main-mix output into a rolling buffer, so a SHIFT+RECORD shortcut can save the last N seconds retroactively (Schwung's Skipback feature). Toggling RUNNING here only starts/stops skipbackHost itself - it does not arm forceAudioJack.so or restart acvs, so it only actually captures anything if ForceAudioJack's own manage.sh ENABLE has already been run. See docs/PROPOSAL-force-audio-jack.md.
